PaperX.AbsoluteIntegralFrobenius.exists_frobenius_at : ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (Q : Ideal ↥PaperX.AbsoluteIntegralFrobenius.IntegralClosure) [Q.IsMaximal] [Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {↑p})],
  ∃ σ,
    ∀ (x : ↥PaperX.AbsoluteIntegralFrobenius.IntegralClosure),
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q) (↑σ • x) = (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q) x ^ p
PaperX.AbsoluteIntegralFrobenius.exists_frobenius : ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  ∃ Q,
    Q.IsMaximal ∧
      Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {↑p}) ∧
        ∃ σ,
          ∀ (x : ↥PaperX.AbsoluteIntegralFrobenius.IntegralClosure),
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q) (↑σ • x) = (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q) x ^ p
PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteArithmeticSeparation.finite_arithmetic_system_separator : ∀ (n : ℕ) [inst : NeZero n]
  (L : Type u_1) [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : NumberField L] [inst_3 : IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ L] {Λ : Type u_2}
  {I : Type u_3} {E : Type u_4} [inst_4 : Field E] [inst_5 : Fintype I] [inst_6 : DecidableEq I] {K : Λ → Type u_5}
  [inst_7 : (l : Λ) → Field (K l)] [∀ (l : Λ), CharZero (K l)] [inst_9 : (l : Λ) → TopologicalSpace (K l)]
  [∀ (l : Λ), IsTopologicalRing (K l)] [∀ (l : Λ), T2Space (K l)] {W : Λ → I → Type u_6}
  [inst_12 : (l : Λ) → (i : I) → AddCommGroup (W l i)] [inst_13 : (l : Λ) → (i : I) → _root_.Module (K l) (W l i)]
  [∀ (l : Λ) (i : I), FiniteDimensional (K l) (W l i)] (ρ : (l : Λ) → (i : I) → Representation (K l) Gal(L/ℚ) (W l i))
  [∀ (l : Λ) (i : I),
      Representation.IsIrreducible (MonoidHom.comp (ρ l i) (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L))]
  (emb : (l : Λ) → E →+* K l) (t : I → PaperX.CyclotomicPrimeCoverage.PermittedPrime n ∅ → E)
  (good : Λ → PaperX.CyclotomicPrimeCoverage.PermittedPrime n ∅ → Prop),
  (∀ (l : Λ), {p | ¬good l p}.Finite) →
    (∀ (l : Λ) (i : I) (p : PaperX.CyclotomicPrimeCoverage.PermittedPrime n ∅),
        good l p →
          Representation.character (MonoidHom.comp (ρ l i) (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L))
              (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.liftSample n L p) =
            (emb l) (t i p)) →
      (∀ (i j : I),
          PaperX.CompatibleSystemRigidity.MemberwiseEquiv
              (fun l i => MonoidHom.comp (ρ l i) (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L)) i j →
            i = j) →
        ∀ (l₀ : Λ) (forbidden : Finset ℕ),
          ∃ v Q γ,
            (Function.Injective fun i => ↑(v i)) ∧
              (∀ (i : I), good l₀ (v i)) ∧
                (∀ (i : I), ↑(v i) ∉ forbidden) ∧
                  (PaperX.FiniteSeparation.sampleMatrix t v).det ≠ 0 ∧
                    (∀ (l : Λ), ((emb l).mapMatrix (PaperX.FiniteSeparation.sampleMatrix t v)).det ≠ 0) ∧
                      (∀ (j : I),
                          (Q j).IsMaximal ∧
                            (Q j).LiesOver (Ideal.span {↑↑(v j)}) ∧
                              γ j ∈ MulAction.stabilizer PaperX.AbsoluteIntegralFrobenius.GQ (Q j) ∧
                                ∀ (x : ↥PaperX.AbsoluteIntegralFrobenius.IntegralClosure),
                                  (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q j)) (γ j • x) = (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q j)) x ^ ↑(v j)) ∧
                        (∀ (j : I),
                            (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L) (γ j) =
                              PaperX.CyclotomicPrimeCoverage.primeSample n L ∅ (v j)) ∧
                          (∀ (l : Λ) (i j : I),
                              ∀ δ ∈ Ideal.inertia PaperX.AbsoluteIntegralFrobenius.GQ (Q j),
                                (MonoidHom.comp (ρ l i) (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L)) δ = 1) ∧
                            ∀ (l : Λ) (j i : I),
                              good l (v j) →
                                (emb l).mapMatrix (PaperX.FiniteSeparation.sampleMatrix t v) j i =
                                  Representation.character
                                    (MonoidHom.comp (ρ l i) (PaperX.CyclotomicAbsoluteSamples.restrictionMap n L)) (γ j)
